selection: Named places only. hospital: amenity or healthcare = hospital. clinic: amenity = clinic or healthcare = clinic/centre. flood_shelter: the name says cyclone/flood shelter or centre.
limitations: Mapped by volunteers; coverage is better in towns than in remote areas. A missing place does not mean none exists.
Not checked on the ground. A place may have closed, moved or be mis-tagged.
Capacity is only present where a mapper recorded it. Value is never present.
